assets.name: ドラゴン
assets.en: Use case: style-transfer. Create one finished transparent RPG battle monster asset. Image 1 is the identity reference: retain this compact red-brown dragon with a broad large head, two pale ochre horns, amber eyes, visible ivory fangs, a rounded upright body with a golden segmented belly, two short clawed forearms, two sturdy clawed hind legs, two spread batlike wings with muted red membranes, and a long tail curving to the viewer right. Keep the compact proportions and all four limbs as well as the separate pair of wings clearly readable. Image 2 is the rendering-style reference: match the carefully painted fantasy bestiary illustration, convincing natural materials, restrained dark contours, precise edge treatment and coherent directional lighting. Translate the dragon into this illustrated asset family with detailed scales in selected areas, broad readable red-brown and gold color masses, two to three principal shading values per material and restrained warm highlights. Use a ready-for-battle stance in a nearly frontal slight three-quarter view. Show the full single creature centered in a square canvas, both wing tips, both horns, both feet and the entire curling tail fully inside the frame, with comfortable transparent margins on every side. The surrounding canvas and all open spaces between the wings and limbs are fully transparent with a clean alpha edge. Deliver the standalone creature illustration ready for a game battle screen.
assets.ja: 旧ドラゴンの赤褐色の体、大きな頭、黄土色の二本角、琥珀色の目、牙、金色の節状の腹、短い両腕と太い両脚、赤い膜の翼、右へ回る尾を維持します。水車ビーバーと同じ絵画的な描き込み・輪郭・光の方向で、鱗と膜の質感を描きます。四肢と翼を明確に分け、角・翼端・足・尾まで全体を正方形の中に収めます。周囲と手足の隙間は背景透過にします。
